behavior: Records keep requested bytes separate from API capacity and cumulative submitted transfer totals. Vertex and glyph owners update requested extent when capacity is reused; uniforms use their logical struct extent. Other textures/query/staging owners request their full API extent. This is prepared request size, not initialized/submitted content or atlas occupied-glyph pixels.

Prepared world-bundle references and submission references maintain separate counts on the same identity. Directly submitted staging owners count exactly once until completion drops them. Shared references do not duplicate capacity.

First retirement cause distinguishes replacement, explicit clear, uncached retirement, transfer to submission and ordinary owner drop. All migrated owners retain fallback owner-drop accounting; explicit vertex/glyph/attachment replacement sites set their more specific cause.

After the GPU resource and its permits drop, a final guard updates fixed-size per-owner and process release totals by cause. Observer and receipt lifetime cannot retain GPU capacity. Released resources disappear from live snapshots even if an accounting receipt survives. No unbounded event log or new trace framework.
